name: Batch Distillation Column Temperature (TC_top)
description: Top-of-column temperature in a laboratory-scale batch distillation plant. Governs separation quality and product purity. Checks whether temperature stays within expected distillation band.

elements.name: Column Top Temperature
elements.description: Temperature at top of distillation column during normal ethanol-water separation. Dataset includes explicit measurement uncertainty estimates from calibrated thermocouples. 119 experiments across operating conditions.

uncertainty.source: Batch Distillation Dataset for ML Anomaly Detection (Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.17395544, Specht et al. 2025). Fault-free ethanol-water experiments. Measurement uncertainty estimates included in dataset. Top temperature oscillates near ethanol boiling point (78.37°C at 1 atm) with 1.8°C std from reflux ratio variation.

elements.name: Maximum Top Temperature for Ethanol Purity
elements.description: Above 81.5°C indicates water breakthrough at column top, degrading product purity below 90% ethanol (azeotrope at 78.1°C at 1 atm; water boils at 100°C)

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(TC_top) = TC_top if TC_top <= TC_top_max, else ∅
consistency_relations.upr_description: The water breakthrough temperature guards the column top temperature uncertainty set; temperatures above 81.5 °C indicate product purity degradation.
